description: This file defines the RichText class, which manages rich text elements within a spreadsheet cell, including creation, manipulation, and rendering of text and text runs.

classes.name: RichText
classes.description: Class for managing rich text elements within a spreadsheet cell, supporting creation, cloning, and text retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new RichText object, optionally attaching it to a cell and copying its style.

methods.name: addText
methods.description: Adds a rich text element to the RichText object.

methods.name: createText
methods.description: Creates a new TextElement with the given text and adds it to the RichText.

methods.name: createTextRun
methods.description: Creates a new Run object with the given text and adds it to the RichText.

methods.name: getPlainText
methods.description: Returns the concatenated plain text of all rich text elements.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the RichText object to its plain text representation.

methods.name: getRichTextElements
methods.description: Returns the array of rich text elements.

methods.name: setRichTextElements
methods.description: Sets the array of rich text elements.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code representing the current state of the rich text elements.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of the RichText object, including its elements.
